name: Minor
definition: Daggers, small weapons, fist weapons and the quarterstaff. Every class has them.

name: Ranged One-Handed
definition: Weapons thrown or shot with one hand.

name: Versatile
definition: Melee weapons used in one or two hands.

name: Ranged Two-Handed
definition: Bows and crossbows that need two hands.

name: Broad One-Handed
definition: One-handed Might melee weapons that aren't versatile.
